prompt: A still from a prime-time adult animated sitcom: flat colours with one shadow tone, slightly wobbly hand-drawn black outlines, simple rounded people with big round eyes, small dot pupils and overbites, faint old film grain. A tall city building cut open in cross-section like a doll's house, seen straight on. In the attic an old woman in a coat shivers by one candle in an ice blue room. At street level a cream and brick red bakery; a red crowd and a blue crowd of mixed ages and skin tones shove each other under a yellow street lamp, a police car beside them. Below, a secret emerald basement in toxic green lamplight: printing presses with cheerful 1930s cartoon faces throw banknotes into the air, gangsters in pinstripe suits play jazz, and a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat and gold chain dances. At the very bottom an orange furnace. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
